app.name: Black Shades
app.long_description:
You are a psychic bodyguard. Keep your client alive: watch the crowd, find the assassin before the shot, and put him down.
Point the Wiimote where you want the gun; the nunchuk stick walks and turns. B fires. See README-wii.md for the rest of the controls.
Black Shades was written by David Rosen for uDevGame 2002 and is under the uDevGame Limited Use License.
